summary: @ornikar/lerna-config 11.0.5 ships obfuscated preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-style obfuscated bootloader (identifiers like `_0x488df8`, per-function property dictionaries wrapping `execFileSync`/`https.get`/`chmodSync`). At install time it checks for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<platform>.zip` into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line obfuscated bundle prefixed with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and using a `WV8StW` string-array rotator. `math_init.js` is not referenced from `index.js` and is executed only by the preinstall path under the downloaded Bun runtime. This alternate-runtime execution pattern bypasses Node-based static analyzers because the payload runs under Bun rather than Node. Running `npm install` on this version therefore executes an opaque, obfuscated payload under the installer's user account with no user interaction. The behavior is unrelated to the declared purpose of a shared lerna configuration helper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
